name: ZED RUN GaslessReservoirEnabler whitelisted-token module allowance drain
summary: GaslessReservoirEnabler.erc20WithTransfersAndExecute is callable by anyone and runs module.call(data) for every ExecutionInfo whose module is on moduleWhitelist, with the calldata entirely caller-controlled. The same contract pulls users' ERC-20s with safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), ...), so users hold standing allowances to it. Once the admin whitelisted the WETH token itself as a module, any caller could make the enabler call WETH.transferFrom(victim, attacker, amount) and spend every user's allowance, breaking the invariant that the enabler moves a user's tokens only on that user's own call or signed meta-transaction.

loss.notes: WETH is the sum of the anchor's 466 transferFrom pulls (8.719916012102510925) and the same attacker's second pass through the same path 21 blocks later (0.130437373635793407). ZED, a second whitelisted token module drained from 165 approvers through the same function, is valued at its realised proceeds: the helper sold it in the same transaction for 0.004146795847693404 WETH. The helper later forwarded exactly the sum of the three legs, 8.854500181585997736 WETH, to the attacker EOA.

ageReset.description: Admin Safe 0xd5daab598cbae5dda1a1a57a60a494e5fcfa82bb, through a MultiSend delegatecall, called setModuleWhitelistStatus(WETH, true) (moduleWhitelist[WETH], mapping slot 5, 0 -> 1). _executeInternal reverts for non-whitelisted modules, so this value is necessary to the WETH drain; the deployment 3.7 hours earlier left it false and it was never toggled afterwards.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and first exercise. Source-1 (Polygon block 94199850 index 80, timestamp 1790004862): attacker EOA 0x46f54c1a86575679fc3d29666c1717e9786279aa calls its helper 0x26a3d1f28de682f116744a5f026848dc0d7862eb (created by the EOA in 0x67304bed66f44cc77871509060a50bfaefd983d68febd98491f0a37ea4f1d36f, block 94199829; owner-gated DrainExecutor bytecode), selector 0x43b26020. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): the helper calls GaslessReservoirEnabler 0x9b58fdadc16e30fba313e044bf9e88689c3f163e erc20WithTransfersAndExecute (0x7dede4cf) directly, with an empty ERC20Transfer array and 466 ExecutionInfos; the enabler issues 466 WETH 0x7ceb23fd6bc0add59e62ac25578270cff1b9f619 transferFrom (0x23b872dd) calls, each moving a different approver's WETH to the helper. Receipt: 466 Transfer and 466 Approval(owner, enabler, remaining) logs plus the MATIC fee log of 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001010; Transfers total 8719916012102510925 wei. Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=137; GaslessReservoirEnabler, v0.8.11+commit.d7f03943, optimizer 200 runs; SHA-256 of SourceCode ffdd7fcb8310a67d4bbde736f08581d6eeef7de74c480dd609f9831102fdbe6b): erc20WithTransfersAndExecute is external nonReentrant with no role; it pulls ERC20Transfers with safeTransferFrom(_msgSender(), this, amount), so users approve the enabler; _executeInternal requires only moduleWhitelist[module] and module.isContract() before module.call{value}(data) with caller-supplied data. moduleWhitelist(WETH) is true at block 94199849. Earliest exercise: Polygon WETH emits Approval(owner, spender, remaining) on every transferFrom (466 in source-1). Etherscan logs Approval(topic2 = enabler) over blocks 54657680..94199850: 9613 logs, 1246 owners, 9148 transactions. Transfer(topic2 = enabler) gives 7723 inbound pulls; every one is in a transaction whose MetaTransactionExecuted (7903 events) names the same owner as userAddress. The 1425 transactions holding an enabler Approval without a same-owner inbound pull were checked by receipt for a WETH Transfer from that owner to any other address: only source-1 matches (466 transfers). ZED 0x5ec03c1f7fa7ff05ec476d19e34a22eddb48acdc, the other whitelisted token module (whitelisted in 0xd7e1dbef0bb759be57fbfe8fb58f225c8bed50059a1001fd861e0f1813b67c57, block 55068594), also emits Approval on transferFrom: 246 enabler Approvals (224 owners) and 167 inbound pulls before block 94199850; the 238 unmatched Approval transactions contain no ZED Transfer from the owner to a non-enabler address. Source-1 is therefore the first successful exercise.

Reviewed complete gross loss; all merged transactions are by the same attacker through the same helper and enabler function. Source-1: 466 WETH transferFrom pulls, total 8719916012102510925 wei. Source-9 (block 94199871 index 73, timestamp 1790004882): callTracer shows helper -> enabler 0x7dede4cf -> 466 WETH transferFrom, receipt Transfers total 130437373635793407 wei to the helper. Source-10 (block 94199890 index 75, timestamp 1790004922): helper -> enabler 0x7dede4cf -> 165 ZED transferFrom (ZED module whitelisted in 0xd7e1dbef0bb759be57fbfe8fb58f225c8bed50059a1001fd861e0f1813b67c57), receipt Transfers total 81210286957137976683311 ZED base units (18 decimals) to the helper, which sends them to pool 0x374552804f7ca26c307c8d31f4cc0d9215c87f46 and receives 4146795847693404 wei WETH. 0xe6e62c5c8bdcc6548f2eb735a1ba33e86fb4cb15be67ef8ba01455bd0125489b (block 94199904, emergencyWithdrawERC20) moves 8854500181585997736 wei WETH from the helper to the EOA, exactly the sum of the three legs. Etherscan Approval(topic2 = enabler) logs for WETH from block 94199851 to 94622048 contain only source-9's 466 and three plain approve() calls (0x13a00644013e7f74a6a1faa25e54cdd9fffe81507f9ba12b7ca28d9e6db6b67e, 0x506b418f5ca3bce0273bc0983b5720fbbcada002ee04f6e9f5d862124ad1a445, 0x31b5ca6860247e4935e760816c43ebe3d14209a69899b8412ac3a646d4913389) with no Transfer. WETH is valued with the DefiLlama polygon:WETH quote at the anchor (source-8); ZED, sold by the attacker in the same transaction, at realised proceeds 4146795847693404 wei x 2737.2329151933777 USD/WETH = 11.35074608689361 USD. The DeFiHackLabs PoC (source-2) reports the anchor leg only.

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. GaslessReservoirEnabler 0x9b58fdadc16e30fba313e044bf9e88689c3f163e is a direct, non-proxy runtime created top-level by 0xfded9eeae607ad5f066d5693fb0a05b7ea0fae14 in source-3 (block 54657680 index 67, timestamp 1710440559); eth_getCode is empty at block 54657679 and keccak256 of the runtime is 0xedee4806dc6e96bd7c7e403cf340dadfa0f585caa4469a378c39616b77cab4f4 at blocks 54657680 and 94199849. Causal configuration: eth_call moduleWhitelist(WETH) is false at 54657680 and binary search fixes the change at block 54663648. moduleWhitelist is mapping slot 5: storage slot keccak256(pad(WETH) . pad(5)) = 0x743dd345c0ac810af2ee4e03097350cde536bf55bdc0e6bd2687a29402e997e6 reads 0 at block 54663647 and 1 at 54663648 and 94199849. In source-4 (block 54663648 index 153) Safe 0xd5daab598cbae5dda1a1a57a60a494e5fcfa82bb execTransaction delegatecalls MultiSend 0x40a2accbd92bca938b02010e17a5b8929b49130d, which calls setModuleWhitelistStatus (0x6b41b243) for WETH, ReservoirApprovalProxy 0x79ce8f93063f8be4573a58f250b003859ebb7a24 and ReservoirV6_0_1 0xc2c862322e9c97d6244a3506655da95f05246fd8, each true. Admin history: the only RoleGranted events are the constructor grant to 0xfded9eea (block 54657680) and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the Safe in 0x0ca93e3d0396ec03fa466fd9a0c217d126a97629c7994e75c2d5d48519cd6102 (block 54658100), where 0xfded9eea's role is revoked (RoleRevoked). Etherscan txlist for the Safe over 54663648..94199850 returns 86 successful transactions; callTracer on each finds non-static calls to the enabler only in source-4 and in 0xd7e1dbef0bb759be57fbfe8fb58f225c8bed50059a1001fd861e0f1813b67c57 (ZED whitelisted, block 55068594), so the WETH flag was never toggled. setModuleWhitelistStatus reverts on an unchanged value, so any re-set would require such a call. The WETH whitelist is the latest pre-exploit change establishing the exploited combination; the later ZED whitelist bears only on the merged ZED leg. Code age 1790004862 - 1710453919 = 79550943 seconds.
